description: This class includes the repair and maintenance of equipment not elsewhere classified.
includes: repair and maintenance of fishing nets, including mending
repair of musical instruments (except pipe organs)
repair of office and household furniture and fixtures
repair of other equipment: medical equipment, measuring equipment used in households
excludes: repair of electrical household appliances, see 9522
repair of computers and peripheral equipment, see 9511
repair of footwear and leather goods, see 9523
